quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products: electronic-grade disilane (4N8-5N) for CVD of dielectric silicon films (poly-Si, SixOy, SixNy), applied in 7nm and lower-node advanced processes and being tested at more advanced nodes; high-purity trisilane (4N) with analog-chip production use; electronic-grade silane (6N) supply service; semiconductor-grade AHF (5N) dry-etch gas, whose facility was completed in 2024 with positive feedback from international wafer fabs, formally introduced into the customer supply chain in 2025. Hong Jie Technology's ultra-high-purity parts cleaning for CVD and etch parts is applied at 5nm, 3nm and lower nodes, alongside APS / SPS ceramic plasma-spray coatings and ESC / showerhead refurbishment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (company): the full-year core target is double-digit revenue growth. Disilane shipments are expected to keep growing strongly as logic moves to 2nm and A14 with GAA / CFET structures, AI PC / AI phone refresh lifts wafer starts, and key customers' new advanced fabs in Taiwan and overseas reach volume production; disilane capacity is to be raised by debottlenecking without major capex. AHF is expected to contribute significantly to revenue from 2026 as the second growth engine, helped by 3D NAND stacks above 300 layers; overseas agency sales are expected to grow with customers' fab expansions.
